name: 25 Degree North Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: The most reliable sit-down restaurant in Ukhrul — top-floor of the Shoppers Hub building behind Viewland Church Gate. Doubles as a 5-room hotel. Limited menu but consistently clean food, and one of the few places in town that serves a proper coffee.
insider_tip: Open early morning to ~8pm. Vegetarian menu is short — call ahead. The view from the top of the building is the best in town.
signature_address: 2nd Floor, Shoppers Hub, Behind Viewland Church Gate, Gandhi Circle Lane, Phungreitang, Ukhrul, Manipur 795142

name: Downtown Cafe
why_it_matters: Locals call this the best burger in Ukhrul — a stand-alone building in the Mini Secretariat parking lot in Hamleikhong, the administrative heart of town. Free parking and recently added cheesecake to the menu.
insider_tip: Skip the menu's longer Asian section and stick to the burgers and fried rice. Closed some Sundays.
signature_address: Mini Secretariat Parking, Hamleikhong, Ukhrul, Manipur 795142

name: Daisies Cakes & Bakes
why_it_matters: Ukhrul's go-to pizza-and-bakes spot — moved from its original Undercroft space to the bottom floor of Zimik Plaza in Viewland. Blueberry cheesecake is the local-Instagram order. Rare to find this kind of bake-shop quality in a Manipur hill town.
insider_tip: Slices are limited and sell out by mid-afternoon. Whole pizzas need ~25 min — order ahead if you're in a hurry.
signature_address: Bottom Floor, Zimik Plaza, Viewland, Ukhrul, Manipur 795142

name: Shimm's Cafe
signature_dish: Chicken burger and beef fried rice
why_it_matters: Sits above Food Stream not far from Magen Hills in Viewland — local food blogger Susan Zingkhai flags it as one of the few cafes open on Sundays in Ukhrul, with strong views and seasonal/holiday decor.
insider_tip: One of the only options on a Sunday. Climb up via the Food Stream entrance — the view side faces the valley.
signature_address: Above Food Stream, near Magen Hills, Viewland, Ukhrul, Manipur 795142
